assets.prompt: A burial jar, 24x24 units: a round Bone urn, pitted, a hairline crack, a dark rim under a flat lid with a round knob, a Void cord bound round its shoulder with stitches across it. Drawn at 2x detail (two art pixels a world unit, drawn at half size in the game) for a top-down pixel game, about its 1x silhouette, size and frames, part by part, each a rod, a ball, a bevelled box or polygon, a barrel's drum, a column or a heap: lit from the top-left in three shades of its material, the base the most, with its material's surface where it has one (wood grain and boards, bone and stone pores, water streaks, a flame's bright core, rivets, a glint in the material's own light shade), a dark seam where a part lies over another and a one-pixel dark outline round the outside. Palette colours from docs/STYLE.md only; no player colours; every pixel fully clear or fully opaque.
